name: io.github.malikmalikayesha/boaviztapi-mcp
title: BoaviztAPI
description: Environmental footprint of cloud instances, servers, GPUs and devices, via BoaviztAPI.

environmentVariables.name: BOAVIZTAPI_URL
environmentVariables.description: BoaviztAPI base URL; use your own instance for regular use

environmentVariables.name: BOAVIZTAPI_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for each BoaviztAPI request

environmentVariables.name: BOAVIZTAPI_DEFAULT_CRITERIA
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated impact criteria used when a tool call names none

environmentVariables.name: BOAVIZTAPI_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to cache list and lookup responses; 0 disables caching
